title: Pokemon Pikachu 018/091 Paldean Fates Trick or Trade Stamped
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText:
Pokémon TCG — Pikachu, #018/091, Paldean Fates (SV4.5), Cosmos Holo. Trick or Trade 2024 stamped promo (Halloween jack-o'-lantern Pikachu stamp).
Basic, HP 70. Attacks: Growl, Pika Bolt (30 dmg). Illustrated by OKACHEKE.
Ungraded, near mint or better — see photos for the actual card. Ships sleeved in a top-loader inside a rigid mailer.
